description: This file implements a microphone interface for Android using OpenSL ES, managing permissions, buffer queues, and recording states within the Cobalt project.

classes.name: SbMicrophoneImpl
classes.description: Implementation of SbMicrophonePrivate for Android using OpenSL ES, handling microphone permissions, buffer management, and recording control.

methods.name: ~SbMicrophoneImpl
methods.description: Destructor that calls Close() to clean up resources.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens the microphone, requests permission if needed, and starts recording.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads available audio data into provided buffer.

methods.name: IsMicrophoneDisconnected
methods.description: Checks if the microphone is disconnected.

methods.name: IsMicrophoneMute
methods.description: Checks if the microphone is muted.

methods.name: StopRecording
methods.description: Stops audio recording and cleans up.

methods.name: CreateAudioRecorder
methods.description: Creates and configures the OpenSL ES audio recorder.

methods.name: DeleteAudioRecorder
methods.description: Destroys the OpenSL ES audio recorder and engine.

methods.name: SwapAndPublishBuffer
methods.description: Static callback to swap buffers and publish new data.

methods.name: SwapAndPublishBuffer
methods.description: Instance method to handle buffer swapping and queuing.
